apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: loop-e2e-provider
spec:
  displayName: Loop Budget E2E Provider
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:{{mockPort}}
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-calls
spec:
  displayName: loop-calls
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-calls
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 3
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            showAssessment: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-tokens
spec:
  displayName: loop-tokens
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-tokens
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 0
            maxTokens: 20
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            showAssessment: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-tools
spec:
  displayName: loop-tools
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-tools
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /mcp
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 0
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 2
            showAssessment: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-duration
spec:
  displayName: loop-duration
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-duration
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 0
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 1
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            windowSeconds: 3600
            showAssessment: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-annotate
spec:
  displayName: loop-annotate
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-annotate
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 1
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            onBreach: annotate
            showAssessment: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-fallback
spec:
  displayName: loop-fallback
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-fallback
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 1
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            showAssessment: true
            sessionKey:
              header: ""
              jsonPath: ""
              fallbackToHash: true
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-unidentified
spec:
  displayName: loop-unidentified
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-unidentified
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 1
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
            showAssessment: true
            sessionKey:
              header: ""
              jsonPath: ""
              fallbackToHash: false
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: loop-invalid
spec:
  displayName: loop-invalid
  version: v1.0
  context: /loop-invalid
  provider:
    id: loop-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: agentic-loop-budget-governor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            maxCalls: 0
            maxTokens: 0
            maxDurationSeconds: 0
            maxConsecutiveIdenticalToolCalls: 0
  accessControl:
    mode: allow_all

item.name: 02 - maxCalls: blocks once the ceiling is exceeded
tiny call -> 200 (well under the token ceiling)
04 - Consecutive identical tool calls are treated as a stuck loop
05a - maxDurationSeconds: first call starts the session clock
05b - maxDurationSeconds: call after the ceiling elapses is blocked
06 - onBreach annotate forwards to the backend with x-loop-budget headers
07 - Session identity falls back to a hash of the system prompt + Authorization
08 - Callers with no resolvable session id share one conservative bucket
unidentified call 2 -> 429 (shares the same bucket as call 1)
09 - Invalid config accepted at registration but the route never enforces
